summary: CONTENT ADMIN FEASIBILITY MATRIX at TNR head 36c5873b (Forge pin 345d18ac): 25 content-class rows + 10 cross-cutting rows. Verdict: for all seven Forge classes (jutsu, item, bloodline, gameAsset, quest, AI, AiProfile) plus guide and badge, a same-origin Forge on the carrier can give an admin holding a canChangeContent role the full draft -> review -> edit -> publish -> delete loop with ZERO game changes, because every step is an existing procedure: hidden/published is flipped only by the whole-record <class>.update (no toggle exists anywhere except worldMap.publishSectorMap and activityStreak.toggleConfigActive), gated resolver-side by canChangeContent returning success:false at HTTP 200. Draft READS need no role for 6 of the 7 Forge classes (public get/getAllNames; getAll honours client hidden:true) - only guide, sageMode lists, evolutions and sectorMap gate drafts on role, so 'hidden' is page-level confidentiality only (Behaviour-proven: committed captures return hidden:true quest bodies). Unhide gates exist for jutsu (appearAnimation+appearSfx), item (WEAPON/battle CONSUMABLE same rule) and quest (sceneCharacters); hiding jutsu/item force-unequips owners. AI has no lifecycle flag: 'publish' = inArena/inShrines/quest or placement references, and every AI is listed to everyone. Native audit: actionLog with server-computed diffs on update/delete for jutsu/item/bloodline/quest/gameAsset/ai/badge/guide/sageMode, never on create/clone; readable per record via public logs.getContentChanges ONLY for LOG_TYPES (ai, badge, bloodline, guide, item, jutsu, ...) - quest, gameAsset and sageMode history is written but unreachable through the API, so Forge captures are the only history there. content_backups is a whole-table prod->dev SQL sync (4 types, admin roles), not restore. Preview: public detail pages 404 hidden rows; only the guide editor has a real preview tab; Forge must self-render (ItemWithEffects is user-context free; quest/objective rendering needs a live tracker and must be re-implemented). Role discovery without credential material: profile.getPublicUser {own userId from window.Clerk.user.id} (one public budget unit) or profile.getUser (protected, unlimited, whole profile). Rate limits: every list/point read an admin queue would poll is publicProcedure 60/60s per path per user shared with the carrier page; protected reads are unlimited. Forge today: registry covers CRUD+publish for the 7 classes but has no delete/clone callers, refuses paged getAll lists (no queue), lacks logs.getContentChanges, relations/evolutions/scene-asset reads and a role pre-check; guide is entirely post-pin (forces a pin move, which the drift reader shows is contract-neutral for the existing 43 paths); badge/sageMode/skillTree/sectorMap/mapAsset/mapTerrain/overworldAi/towerDefense/rankedSeason/activityStreak/raidThreshold/itemVariant/reskins are staff-managed classes with no Forge coverage, most with NO native audit log. Disagreements reconciled: ai.getAiProfile on an unknown id yields INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (fetchAiProfileById throws a plain Error before the router's NOT_FOUND branch, ai.ts:180-190 vs 31-33); quest sceneCharacters gate spans quests.ts:764-781 (both readers' ranges overlap it); jutsu unequip side effect is at jutsu.ts:817-824.

rows.topic: Rate limits on the read paths an admin queue would poll
rows.finding: publicProcedure = ratelimitMiddleware + sentryMiddleware (slidingWindow(60,'60 s') per `${path}-${userId ?? userIp}`); protectedProcedure = enforceUserIsAuthed + sentryMiddleware with NO limiter (app/src/server/api/trpc.ts:121-126,201-203,220-222 @tnr-src (head 36c5873b)). Every draft-queue/list read in scope (jutsu/item/bloodline/quests/gameAsset .getAll and .get, badge/guide .getAll/.get, logs.getContentChanges, profile.getAllAiNames/getPublicUsers) is publicProcedure and shares the per-(path,user) 60/60s window with the carrier page's own tRPC traffic (Forge mounts over /profile after HomeLanding's push; forge-inventory 'rate-budget'). A trip costs the user movedTooFastCount+1, money*0.99, bank*0.99 (trpc.ts:121-126 @tnr-src (head 36c5873b); reader-cited (not re-read by this merger): 161-181). Protected reads that an admin surface would use are UNLIMITED: profile.getAi, ai.getAiProfile, worldMap.listSectorMaps/getSectorMapById, activityStreak.getConfigs, raids.getQuestThresholds, staff.getBackups (trpc.ts:220-222 @tnr-src (head 36c5873b)). Paging limits: jutsu.getAll 1000, item/bloodline/quests/gameAsset/badge getAll 500, getPublicUsers 100, getContentChanges 100 per call (routers as cited per class). Forge's local mirror keeps allowance floor(60*0.5)=30 per path per minute and never retries (forge/src/budget/bucket.mjs:1-32).
rows.implication_for_forge: A polling admin queue must (a) use paged getAll with hidden:true at <= a few calls per minute per path, (b) prefer name-list snapshots + point reads over repeated full lists, (c) never poll faster than the shared window allows because the carrier page shares it, (d) treat TOO_MANY_REQUESTS as a halt with countdown (existing Forge behaviour). Design for pull-on-demand or long intervals (>= 1 min), not live polling.
rows.would_need_game_change: none; a protected, unlimited staff list endpoint would remove the constraint
